_readme: Promo codes for estimates. Matching ignores letter case. Each code has appliesToLabor: false means the discount comes off window material only (the windows line, including per-window options), never installation. Set appliesToLabor true only for a code that should also discount labor. percent = that percent off. bogo = one free window per (buy + get) windows, using the cheapest window material price. NOBLEBOGO is buy 4 get 1, so one free window per 5 (5–9 windows discounts one, 10–14 discounts two, and so on). A bogo code with fewer windows than buy+get is still valid and discounts $0.
